description_en: Queries the global API MCP Server configuration for a user. The configuration includes settings for public network access and the whitelist of source VPC IDs for requests from a VPC
description_zh: 查询用户全局API MCP Server配置，当前能力包含配置是否开启公网访问及配置在VPC下请求的来源VPC ID白名单
name: GetApiMcpServerUserConfig

accountId.description_en: The ID of your Alibaba Cloud account
accountId.description_zh: 您的阿里云账号（主账号）ID

enablePublicAccess.description_en: Specifies whether to enable public network access for all API MCP Servers, including system MCP Servers, under your account. By default, this feature is enabled. If you disable it, you can access the servers only through VPC domain names
enablePublicAccess.description_zh: 是否开启账户下所有API MCP Server（包含系统MCP Server）的公网访问能力，默认为开启，关闭后只能通过VPC域名访问

gmtCreate.description_en: The time when the configuration was created

gmtModified.description_en: The time when the configuration was last updated

vpcWhitelists.description_en: The whitelist of source VPCs that are allowed to send requests after public network access is disabled. If you do not set this parameter or leave it empty, requests from all sources are allowed
vpcWhitelists.description_zh: 关闭公网访问后，限定来源的VPC白名单，不设置或为空表示不限制来源

items.description_en: The ID of a source VPC in the whitelist
items.description_zh: 每一个限定的VPC白名单，值为来源VPC ID
